title.zh: CKBFS V3 约束（witness 文件存储，backlink 移入 witness）
title.en: CKBFS V3 Constraints (witness file storage, backlinks moved into witnesses)

subtitle.zh: 来源：code-monad/ckbfs @4ee6689（tag v3）contracts/ckbfs/src/entry.rs + contracts/ckb-adler32（mode 3）　·　data1 0xb5d1…d695（主网 + 测试网）
subtitle.en: Source: code-monad/ckbfs @4ee6689 (tag v3) contracts/ckbfs/src/entry.rs + contracts/ckb-adler32 (mode 3)　·　data1 0xb5d1…d695 (mainnet + testnet)

outputs.label: CKBFS cell
witnesses[index]（head）
outputs.body: "CKBFS" ‖ 0x03 ‖ {{prev tx_hash = 0×32}} ‖ {{prev index = 0}} ‖ prev checksum ‖ next ‖ content

cons.zh: 创建 = 0；更新 = 输入 out_point.tx_hash

role.zh: 上一 head witness 序号

cons.zh: 创建 = 0；更新 = 输入 data.index

cond.zh: 同一 tx 中该 type 的输出 ≤ 1
cond.en: ≤ 1 output with this type in the tx

cond.zh: ≥ 32 字节；args[0..32] 按 type_id 规则
cond.en: ≥ 32 bytes; args[0..32] by the type_id rule

cond.zh: 存在且 ≥ 50 字节；上一位置全 0
cond.en: exists and ≥ 50 bytes; previous position all zero

cond.zh: 含 data hash = 校验器 code hash 的 cell（解码器不检查）
cond.en: contains a cell whose data hash = the hasher code hash (not checked by the decoder)

cond.zh: exec ckb-adler32 mode 3：head[50..] ‖ 沿 next 链各 witness[4..]；prev checksum ≠ 0 时从它恢复；结果 = data.checksum
cond.en: exec ckb-adler32 mode 3: head[50..] ‖ witness[4..] along the next chain; resume from prev checksum when ≠ 0; result = data.checksum

inputs.label: CKBFS cell
inputs.body: Cell{ type: CKBFS_V3, data: { index: i0, checksum: c0, content_type, filename } }

outputs.label: CKBFS cell
outputs.body: Cell{ type: same, data: { index: {{i1}}, checksum: {{c1}}, content_type, filename } }

cond.zh: 上一位置 = (输入 out_point.tx_hash, 输入 data.index)
c1 = c0 走“转移”分支，否则“追加”分支；两者都 exec 同一 mode 3 校验（adler32 忽略传入的恢复参数，只用 head 里的 prev checksum）
cond.en: c1 = c0 takes the "transfer" branch, otherwise "append"; both exec the same mode-3 check (adler32 ignores the passed resume argument and uses the head's prev checksum)

cond.zh: 有输入无输出 → 失败

notes.zh: 版本：仓库没有写出 0xb5d1…d695 的发布记录（README 只列 V1/V2）。链上 V3 部署的 dep_group 里 ckb-adler32 data hash = 0xbd94…1db1，与 hash.rs 在 3776e2a 之后（含 931c477、tag v3 = 4ee6689）固定的值相同，所以按 tag v3 记录；具体构建提交未证实，未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Version: the repo has no release record for 0xb5d1…d695 (the README lists only V1/V2). The ckb-adler32 data hash in the on-chain V3 dep_group is 0xbd94…1db1, the value hash.rs pins from 3776e2a on (incl. 931c477 and tag v3 = 4ee6689), so tag v3 is recorded; the exact build commit is unproven and no reproducible build was attempted.

notes.zh: 数据结构来自 crates.io ckbfs-types 0.3.0（schemas/ckbfs.mol）；witness 布局见 RFC.v3.md 与 ckb-adler32 process.rs。
notes.en: The data layout comes from crates.io ckbfs-types 0.3.0 (schemas/ckbfs.mol); the witness layout from RFC.v3.md and ckb-adler32 process.rs.

notes.zh: 按源码原样：error.rs 定义了 110 InvalidWitnessHeader / 111 InvalidVersion，但 entry.rs 没有使用；版本字节 ≠ 0x03 由 adler32 以 -101 拒绝，"CKBFS" 魔数不检查。
notes.en: As written: error.rs defines 110 InvalidWitnessHeader / 111 InvalidVersion but entry.rs never uses them; a version byte ≠ 0x03 is rejected by adler32 with -101, and the "CKBFS" magic is not checked.

notes.zh: ckbfs 不要求 head 里的 prev checksum 等于输入 checksum，adler32 直接用 head 中的值恢复。
notes.en: ckbfs does not require the head's prev checksum to equal the input checksum; adler32 resumes from the head value as given.
